description.value: Sparkes Corn Barn is a family-owned seasonal operation that has been growing and selling fresh sweet corn in the Chilliwack area since 1998, running multiple drive-thru stands across the Fraser Valley and Okanagan. The Whatcom Road location is a drive-thru stand at a Shell station, selling corn picked fresh from the field daily along with strawberries, raspberries, and blueberries. All corn is non-GMO and delivered directly from the farm on the day of harvest.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sparkes Corn Barn as a real, family-owned seasonal drive-thru produce stand operating since 1998, with the 2061 Whatcom Road location explicitly listed as 'WHATCOM Shell: 2061 Whatcom Road, Abbotsford' on the Locations page — contradicting the OSM community tag of Chilliwack. The front page states 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON – 2025' and the Fraser Valley locations are all marked closed, indicating the business is currently out of season. No bike parking, water refill, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community tag lists this location as Chilliwack, but the website Locations page explicitly identifies it as 'WHATCOM Shell: 2061 Whatcom Road, Abbotsford' — address corrected to Abbotsford.
Website front page and Locations page both state 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON – 2025'; business is seasonal (summer only) and currently closed.
Phone number (778.704.0671) is from website contact page only — OSM has no phone number to cross-check.
This is a drive-thru stand located at a Shell station, not a standalone store; the main farm/barn address is 46265 Prairie Central Rd, Chilliwack, BC V2R 4L8.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, long-established seasonal produce stand selling fresh local corn and berries — a legitimate stop for touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley in summer.
enrichment_extras.notes: Seasonal summer operation only. The Locations page shows multiple Fraser Valley and Okanagan stand locations; this OSM record corresponds specifically to the Whatcom Shell station stand.
